∀ (Q : LR.Residue p K), letI := Q.phi.toAlgebra
  ∀ (f : LR.MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V)
    (G : LR.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[LR.R p] LR.MR p M),
    LR.IotaSpec p M f → LR.GammaPure p K M Q.phi G →
    ∀ (s : Module.End ℂ V) (u : Module.End K (LR.VK K M)), LR.Lift K M s u →
    ∃ F : Module.End (LR.R p) (LR.MR p M),
      (∀ z, f (F z) = s (f z)) ∧
      (∀ z, u (G.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[LR.R p] z)) =
        G.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[LR.R p] F z))
proof:
intro Q
letI := Q.phi.toAlgebra
intro f G hf hG s u hu
rcases hu with ⟨fm, hm, hu⟩
refine ⟨fm.baseChange (LR.R p), ?_, ?_⟩
· intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul r m =>
    simp only [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, hf.1, hm, map_smul]
  | add z w hz hw => simp only [map_add, hz, hw]
· intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul r m =>
    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, hG.2, hG.2, hu]
  | add z w hz hw => simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, hz, hw]

checked : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [fieldK : Field K] (V : Type u_2) [addV : AddCommGroup V] [modV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (p : ℕ)
  (l : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (rho : ↥LR.L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : ↥LR.L) (v : V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ 0 ≤ l ∧ l < ↑p →
    LR.N1 l (rho x) (rho y) (rho h) v →
      LR.N2 p l K M rho x y h v →
        (∀ (Q : LR.Residue p K), LR.MatrixTransport p l K M rho x y h v Q) →
          LR.SmallPowers l K M rho x y h →
            ∀ (Q : LR.Residue p K) (f : LR.MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (G : LR.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[↥(LR.R p)] LR.MR p M),
              LR.IotaSpec p M f →
                LR.GammaPure p K M Q.phi G →
                  ∀ (s : Module.End ℂ V) (u : Module.End K (LR.VK K M)),
                    LR.Lift K M s u →
                      ∃ F,
                        (∀ (z : LR.MR p M), f (F z) = s (f z)) ∧
                          ∀ (z : LR.MR p M), u (G.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[↥(LR.R p)] z)) = G.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[↥(LR.R p)] F z)
